questions.stem: The ___ of the new software has reduced our costs.

why_wrong: A : adjectif : après « the » et avant « of », un nom est attendu.
B : participe passé.
D : verbe : après « the » on attend un nom.
A: adjective: a noun is expected after 'the' and before 'of'.
B: past participle.
D: verb: a noun is expected after 'the'.

questions.stem: Our team works ___ to meet every deadline.

why_wrong: A : nom pluriel.
B : adjectif : on attend un adverbe qui modifie « works ».
C : nom.
A: plural noun.
B: adjective: an adverb modifying 'works' is expected.
C: noun.

questions.stem: We are looking for a ___ candidate with five years of experience.

why_wrong: B : verbe.
C : sens actif inadapté (un candidat qualifié, pas qui qualifie).
D : nom : devant « candidate », on attend un adjectif.
B: verb.
C: unsuitable active meaning (a qualified candidate, not one who qualifies).
D: noun: an adjective is expected before 'candidate'.

questions.stem: Mr. Wu was ___ promoted to regional director last year.

fr.rule: Entre l'auxiliaire et le participe : adverbe.
why_wrong: A : nom rare.
C : adjectif : un adverbe est attendu entre « was » et le participe.
D : nom rare.

en.rule: Between the auxiliary and the participle: adverb.
why_wrong: A: rare noun.
C: adjective: an adverb is expected between 'was' and the participle.
D: rare noun.

questions.stem: All employees must follow the safety ___ posted on the wall.

why_wrong: B : verbe.
C : adverbe.
D : adjectif : on attend un nom après « safety ».

en.rule: Compound noun (safety regulations): a noun is expected.
why_wrong: B: verb.
C: adverb.
D: adjective: a noun is expected after 'safety'.

questions.stem: The company's ___ growth has attracted many investors.

why_wrong: A : Nom rare : un adjectif est attendu.
B : Nom : un adjectif est attendu.
C : Adverbe : un adjectif est attendu devant un nom.
A: Rare noun: an adjective is expected.
B: Noun: an adjective is expected.
C: Adverb: an adjective is expected before a noun.

questions.stem: Sales have increased ___ since the new campaign.

why_wrong: A : Adjectif (prévenant) : mauvais sens et mauvaise nature.
C : Adjectif : un adverbe est attendu pour modifier « increased ».
D : Nom : un adverbe est attendu.
A: Adjective (thoughtful): wrong meaning and wrong word class.
C: Adjective: an adverb is needed to modify 'increased'.
D: Noun: an adverb is expected.

questions.stem: Mr. Ito's ___ to the team was recognized with an award.

why_wrong: A : Gérondif ou participe : le sens ne convient pas ici.
C : Verbe : un nom est attendu après « 's ».
D : Adjectif rare : un nom est attendu.
A: Gerund or participle: the meaning does not fit here.
C: Verb: a noun is expected after "'s".
D: Rare adjective: a noun is expected.
